title: Audio Memo Failed Event
description: A stage of the voice memo journey failed. stage says where; retryable says whether the watcher will try that stage again. Part of the voice memo journey: every stage fact and the agent invocation share correlationid = data.memo_id and ordering_key 'memo:<memo_id>'. See bloodbank/docs/event-naming.md.

memo_id.description: Journey id: uuid5(NAMESPACE_URL, 's3://holocene-auto/' + s3_key). Also the correlationid of this event and of the agent invocation command, so one correlationid query returns the whole journey.

s3_key.description: Object key of the voice memo in the holocene-auto bucket: inbox/<agent>/<yyyy>/<mm>/<dd>/<file>.

target_agent_id.description: Agent the memo is addressed to. Parsed from the S3 key path only, never inferred from audio.

stage.description: Pipeline stage that failed. agent = the gateway turn failed or was rejected; agent_reply = no reply text arrived (error_code timeout: the watcher gave up waiting; no_reply_text: empty; turn_timeout: the gateway stopped the agent's turn at its per-turn wall clock). record = the device could not capture audio (mic unavailable, empty capture); s3_key is the key the memo would have had. upload = the PUT never completed (short body, retries exhausted on the device). playback = the Agent Pad could not play the spoken reply (autoplay blocked, decode or network error); for this stage s3_key is the reply object and the failure is always retryable.

error_code.description: Short machine-readable code. For stage record: silent_capture = the pad measured the whole recording under -60 dBFS (see capture) and held it back, nothing was uploaded. For stage transcribe: silent_audio = the recording is digital silence or near it (audio_max_dbfs below the watcher's threshold, default -60 dBFS), so the microphone delivered no sound and no transcription was run; empty_transcript = the audio was audible (see audio_max_dbfs) but no words were recognised; garbage_transcript = a typical Whisper hallucination on noise; too_short; undecodable_audio; timeout.

audio_max_dbfs.description: stage transcribe: loudest sample of the recording in dBFS (see memo.transcribed). Present on every transcribe-stage failure that happened after the level was measured, including silent_audio.

audio_mean_dbfs.description: stage transcribe: mean volume in dBFS, same measurement as audio_max_dbfs.

audio_duration_seconds.description: stage transcribe: length of the recording in seconds.

capture.description: Input level measured on the device while it recorded (Agent Pad, from the native recorder's getMaxAmplitude or a browser AnalyserNode). Absent when the host cannot measure. peak_dbfs below -60 means no sound reached the microphone: a healthy path never produces it, a stuck emulator capture stream or muted mic always does.

peak_dbfs.description: Loudest 100 ms window of the whole recording, dBFS. -96 is digital silence.

rms_dbfs.description: RMS of the per-window peaks over the recording, dBFS (an upper bound on true RMS).

source.description: native (Holocene Auto MediaRecorder) or analyser (browser Web Audio).

sent_anyway.description: True when the pad had flagged the recording as silent and the operator chose to send it anyway.

retryable.description: True when the watcher will retry the stage; false when the journey ended here.

command_id.description: command_id when the failure happened after dispatch.

lane.description: error_code turn_timeout only: lane of the timed-out command.

elapsed_seconds.description: error_code turn_timeout only: seconds the gateway let the agent turn run before stopping it.

timeout_seconds.description: error_code turn_timeout only: the wall-clock budget that expired.

timeout_source.description: error_code turn_timeout only: lane = the lane's turn_timeout_seconds, envelope = a shorter data.deadline_seconds on the command.

turn_stopped.description: error_code turn_timeout only: false when Hermes did not confirm the turn stopped.
